case.title: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Your offer is clear, and we would like to give you what a supplier with tight capacity needs most: a binding volume and planning security over a longer term.

Option A is the package we can approve. It commits us to the full volume for the whole contract term, and it takes your own lead time into account, so you can plan your seal capacity with us well ahead.

On the cost side:
Our cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010).

On quality:
Your quality was 270 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70410@2026Q3).

On price history:
Our orders of Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM with you were placed at EUR 29.89 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011517-10), EUR 29.89 on 2025-05-19 (po:4500012472-10), EUR 29.89 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013451-10) and EUR 29.89 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014436-10): the price has been unchanged.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 28.50; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 24 months; lead time 42 days.
Binding volume in every option: 23,400 units a year over 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

For your pricing committee or head office, in plain words: Option A gives Ravensteiner a firm, binding volume for the full contract term from a customer with a steady order record, so your capacity can be planned without uncertainty. Please take Option A to the committee on that basis.

We would like to close this calmly and reliably, and we look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge your data and accept the binding volume of 23,400 units over a 24-month contract term.

A reduced lead time of 42 days would necessitate a price premium. Which volume can you commit to?

Our Angebot is a price of €33.60 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.

Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 54 days: €31.70 per unit, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

You asked us to decide, and we are ready to: we accept your alternative proposal as offered, with the binding volume you have taken up over the full contract term.

For us this is a commitment built for planning security. You can schedule your seal capacity with Hollerau Pumpenwerke well ahead, and we can plan our own production around your supply.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 31.70; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 24 months; lead time 56 days.
Binding volume in every option: 23,400 units a year over 24 months.

If you confirm this as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. Should your pricing committee or management need to approve it, this is a short version they can take as it is: Hollerau commits to the full agreed volume every year for the whole contract term, which gives your capacity planning a firm and reliable basis with us.

We would be glad if you took this proposal to them, and we look forward to your confirmation.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your acceptance of our alternative proposal with the adjusted lead time of 56 days. 

We accept your proposal of €31.70 per unit for a volume of 23,400 units per year over a 24-month contract term. For our offer, Lieferzeit is 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. We can accept your terms and await your order. We will process the order confirmation accordingly. 

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. This Angebot remains valid for 14 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
